notes.title: Yomi Alliance 1.1.0 update
notes.notes:
An update for Yomi Alliance has been released.

This update fixes the "neverending loop" some players experienced after week 17 in Academy, and it prevented to access the missions after it. It was very tricky to find the bug since it only happened if some choices were made during the game, causing an instruction over a few dozens to misbehave.

I thank you for your feedback and constant help you gave me to find this bug allowing me to fix it. If you encounter any other issue, please send me a mail to bugs[at]brunimultimedia.com, I always reply to your envaluable feedback.

notes.title: New patch in progress... ready for the mission?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/463655a2952b781b4d9424ffe9da7ecebeb759a9.png[/img]

[i]Ship's Commander's Log.
We are one week into a patrol of the Kressari border. 
Our Kressari friends continue to trail us on their side of the border, but there has been no sign of hostility.
Being this close has the crew on edge, especially since it's the first assignment for many of them, but I have no reason to believe this will be anything other than ordinary.

Ship’s Commander's Log, Supplemental. I may have spoken too soon. We have received a priority one message from the Alliance ordering us to the Joural system, just on the edge of the border, to lend
assistance to a research base that has gone silent after sending out a disturbing message. 
Looks like our routine patrol is going to be anything but.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/1b30e1f3eac23b5cd9a2719d54d89706473cd698.png[/img]

Located on the Joural System, the base is of little strategic importance to the Navy. The majority of the structure is on the “port-side,” including housing, recreation, and operations areas (including the shuttlebay). The “starboard-side” contains the research labs. Two surface tubes, just under 5km long, connect the two halves by a tram system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/2df0ce8cdbca10547b251c8ef11f735ea5052216.png[/img]

[i]Ship's Commander's Log, supplemental. The base is in chaos. The dead litter the halls and roaming bands of crazed crew are clearly responsible.
A madness has taken hold of the Research base, caused by an unknown pathogen. Unless we can restore power, there is little chance of getting the situation under control.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/cdbd33b5285ade97f900ad349b7262af2e1b976a.png[/img]

Are the Kressari responsible? Is the event not connected at all with the Prophet's threat, as it looks like?

notes.title: Yomi Alliance - First Assignment - Update preview
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow officers!

Today I'm announcing you the newest update for Yomi Alliance, which I'm working very hard and passionately to, which will also deliver you the first space mission outside of the Academy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/f5ed76ae1a031ca336fa21b80628b817289cb3f6.png[/img]

After the graduation event, which has been improved as well, you will embark on a journey aboard the Y.S.S. Oraga, as previously announced, and you will be tasked with answering a distress call from an alien vessel carrying Nixanti inmates who have escaped from a Kressari high-security compound.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/0495941ae7c05da08f48cdffd8e9aa005560c476.png[/img]

As different career choices have been made, you will face different scenarios for each and any of them.

[list]
[*] As a [b]Commander[/b], help Captain Marston to deal with a Kressari Security starship without ending in a space battle. Manage your crew and their reactions and, if the situation escalates to violence, order battle stations
[*] As a [b]Security guard[/b], meet the Nixanti fugitives and assist Lt. Mkrell in making sure they're properly welcomed, while keeping security procedures ready and limiting their access throughout the ship
[*] As a [b]Doctor[/b], heal the fugitives' wounds and attend to wounded people in case of a starship battle
[*] As an [b]Operations Officer[/b] deal with the ship systems and analyze the strange readings coming from the Kressari ship, which are doing something unusual over your computer
[*] As a [b]Scientist[/b], interview the fugitives with Captain Marston and try to understand if their claims are true
[*] As a [b]Counselor[/b], assist the fugitives' psychological needs and help them overcome the violence they suffered from their captors
[*] As an [b]Engineer[/b], try to study the fugitives' data banks and boost your own ship systems in case of a battle.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/851fbbaf262966afd9c4ea423e5462697af0bcfe.png[/img]

The update will feature:
[list]
[*] A new, full mission with hours of gameplay with different paths for each career
[*] Finish the Academy storyline or jump directly to the new mission from the game's interface with pre-determined skill levels
[*] New interactions with your crewmates
[*] New story interaction with Jared, if you chose him to be your assistant
[*] More than 200 new high-res images and new lighting system for the ship's renders
[*] New uniform sets for male characters
[*] First of 10 missions which will take you to the final release of the game (Q4 2022)
[*] Sexy situations on the ship to explore
[*] Dozens of bug fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/d9e4d174f23d122826bd6737332ae1ff43145f41.png[/img]

I hope the new big update will entertain you.

The update is due for Steam's Christmas Sales!

Thank you for your support!!!

Stay safe and healthy,

notes.title: Update 0.0.23 is finally out!
notes.notes:
An update for Yomi Alliance is available for download!

[b]WARNING[/b]
Due to the big changes introduced in this update, it is mandatory to start a new game in order to avoid crashes and/or unexpected behavior with previously saved games. I apologize for any discomfort with this but since the game it's Beta I had to make a lot of changes to make the game work properly and in a way that as many players as possible enjoy every story introduced.

I will try to keep the "game reset" as rare as possible, but this time a New Game is recommended.

[b]Bug fixing[/b]
[list]
[*] Various minor bux fixing
[*] Sulijan won't mention The Prophet during her romance interactions unless you actually met him
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented to choose the "Have sex" with Serena option in her quarters
[*] Fixed a crashing issue during Serena's flirting conversations
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will now be able to choose only a Major specialization. This has been done after analyzing the game's data and noticing that players didn't choose many different career options as expected. As a result, a lot of available content, mission and storytelling was missed by players who didn't replay the game more than once. To make the game more enjoyable (and to shorten update times), specializations are now Command, Medical, Security, Operations, Counseling and Science. Every available content is still in the game, even more accessible than before.
[*] You can now start a romance path with Mivak and unlock his "Flirt" option, provided you got enough Intellect and Relationship with him (45).
[*] Academy game weeks are now 20 (down from 24) to better balance the various chapters and skill gain before the starship part of the game
[/list]

[b]Story[/b]
[list]
[*] New story chapter: "Reconstruct the Star Maps" added on week 8
[*] New story chapter: "Shipbuilding" added on week 9
[*] New story chapter: "Alien Diplomacy" added on week 10

[*] New story chapter: "Planetary Survey" added on week 13

[*] New story chapter: "The Kolar Device" added on week 7 (Science career only)
[*] New story chapter: "Rebuilding the Academy" added on week 7 (Engineer career only)
[*] New story chapter: "Kressari Autopsy" added on week 7 (Medical career only)
[*] New story chapter: "Civilian Containment" added on week 7 (Security career only)
[*] New story chapter: "Damage Report" added on week 7 (Operations career only)
[*] New story chapter: "Fear and Courage" added on week 7 (Counseling career only)
[*] New story chapters related to Aberoin in the aftermath of the Prophet's attack, with an option to start a romance with hem

[b]Various[/b]

notes.title: Yomi Alliance will receive a MAJOR update in a few days!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow space officers.

It has been a while since the last update for Yomi Alliance, and that's because of previously stated personal and family issues which I still have to sort out completely. Still, I have released two different games in the meantime and also an episode for The Coroner Saga (Episode 5 is on its way too and I have a huge, nice surprise for Episode 6 which will close the season).

But we're here to talk about Yomi Alliance, today, and it's going to receive a HUGE update.

I started to look at the game's data a few months ago and noticed that most of the players were not choosing many careers as I thought. Most of you stick with the most "famous" ones, and this led to many, many hours of scripting and gameplay that was not ultimately enjoyed unless you replayed the game again and again, which is very unlikely according to the stats.

So I decided to remove sub-careers and make only primary ones available, such as:
[list]
[*] Command
[*] Science
[*] Security
[*] Operations
[*] Counseling
[*] Medical
[*] Engineering
[/list]

This won't mean you will lose different sub-missions or anything, just that you will access more content, special abilities and missions right from your first playthrough, with a lot of such content releasing over the next update.

[b]In the next update you can expect to find a lot of sub-stories, different missions and interactions with your crewmates.[/b]

Unfortunately, this will also mean that[b] you wlil have to start a new game[/b] once updated, because of these changes affecting the way the game works. Loading a previous game might result in bugs, unexpected behavior and crashes, so you are warned.

I always try to keep the need of restarting a new game as low as possible, but with the changes I made, this time, it will be impossible. The changes are also the reason because the update took so long, since I have to rethink about the whole game experience, but that's what alphas are for, after all.

Your feedback, your help and support are making this possible. And I plan to release a beta of the game in a few months, with the final release planned very soon while I finish writing the story, adding images, sexual content and voiceovers, which will cover the most important parts of the game.

I hope you'll enjoy the game as it releases and I hope to see you out there, in outer space!

Stay safe and healthy!

ANDREA

notes.title: Still a few more days to the next patch...
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow space officers!

This announcement is to inform you that the next patch is still work in progress: it is one of the biggest update released for the game, and I'm taking all the necessary time to deliver it to ensure it's as bug free as possible.

With 10 brand-new, class-specific missions to read through, new interactions with Mivak (and a complete romance with him for male characters too!), new HD images, the road to "Graduation" update which will mark the start of the second part of the journey, the addition of new lines for both Mkrell and Sulijan played by amazing actors Manu Intirayimi and Lana Leslie, I'm sure you'll like Yomi's newest update.

I am also working on releasing Hotel Paris, the newest Otome non-adult visual novel, the next episode for the adult game "The Devil's Shoes" while I recently released Episode 4 of "The Coroner Saga".

It has been a VERY challenging year. I had to endure a lot on both personal, family and professional life, but I'm going through it, especially with your help and support.

Yomi Alliance will be an unique visual novel, for better or worse, but believe me when I say that it won't disappoint you, because I'm putting all my effort on it. It already contains 180.000 words and will grow more and more, probably reaching over a million before release.

Sexual interactions you start on the Academy Grounds will go on further during the "Ship Assignment", as well as your friendship with other main characters. I'm planning a lot of content for the game in the future, so don't miss it!

Stay safe and healthy, and thank you for following my games.

ANDREA

notes.title: Next update to feature the end of "Academy Days"
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow officers!

Even though the situation is still very difficult, work on Yomi Alliance has only slowed down, but it never stopped. Today I'm proud to announce you that the next big update for the game, available in late May, will feature the end of "Academy Days", the first part of this adventure.

This will mean that every story arc will be available and concluded, every different mission objective for each career will be released and your characters will be introduced to "Graduation Day", which will be this summer's update!

[b]Wait, does it mean the game is completed?[/b]
Of course not! The first 24 weeks at the Academy will be only the beginning of the game. As I fix bugs, apply your suggestions and watch your feedback, the real story of Yomi Alliance will unfold update after update.

[b]The first part of the game is fun, but repetitive. If I want to try the second part of the game without having to play the first one again, will I be able to do so?[/b]

Of course! A new character creation will be made available for those who want to try the 2nd part of the game without having to go through the Academy. Of course, remember to choose different careers to unlock different scenarios.

[b]PART II – Officer Life[/b]
You graduated from the Academy and assigned to the [i]Y.S.S. Oraga[/i], a state-of-the-art recon vessel commanded by Vessel Captain Marston. All your fellow recruits have been promoted and assigned to the Oraga. Some of the instructors were also hand-picked by Captain Marston for the ship's roster.

Players will have different tasks depending on their career choice, so each story will play differently in content during the six missions of Part II. 

The following is the general plot of Part 2, without a detailed career path.
[b]Mission 1[/b]	
The Oraga responds to a distress call from a Nixanti freighter which is under attack by Kressari Forces inside Alliance Space. Upon interception the Kressari claim the freighter hosts dangerous Nixanti terrorists who fled from a high-security detention world. The Nixanti are freed after a confrontation (either by diplomacy or battle) and granted the request for protection. One of the rescued people is a young Kressari who recognizes the player as the Doombringer of her past visions. She also claims the planet Hurwada II is the staging ground for an Alliance invasion of Kressa.

[b]Mission 2[/b]	
Captain Marston orders to investigate the reports about Hurwada II. After arriving at the planet the Oraga is hailed by Fuminoid Administrator 9T37 who asks them to leave as the entire planet is under military secrecy. Captain Marston asks the player to investigate with an Away Team but is then forced to leave the sector when Fuminoid ships arrive in force.
 
[b]Mission 3[/b]	
Jerath Station, a Human scientific facility, is attacked by unknown assailants. The Oraga is dispatched to investigate. The attacking vessel is unknown but trace elements leave the crew to suspect Nixanti involvement. The vessel disappeared from sensors as it possessed something like a "cloaking device", but this technology is not known to exist in Alliance space, nor in the neighboring empires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/2deb0c244e6358310406a1eb6a3b454c221a50f7.png[/img]

[b]Mission 4[/b]	
The Oraga investigates the disappearance of prominent human scientist Rachel Orlais, who was apparently kidnapped while on leave to Bujuri Prime with her husband, who has been killed in a brutal way. Investigations made by the player might lead to link Orlais' work to an ominous Fuminoid sect called "The Keepers of Time", whose agenda is unknown even by Fuminoid government.

[b]Mission 5[/b]	
Following the trail of the Keepers of Time the Oraga arrives to the planet Jubinai V, home to a remote colony of Nixanti and Fuminoids who established it way before the Yomi Treaty was signed. Completely unaware of the Alliance and their own species' recent history, the colonists referring themselves as "Fuminanti" have formed a cult around the figure of the "Doombringer". Upon investigating further, the Oraga crew discovers ancient texts referring to an "Artifact" in deep space who could empower its owner with god-like powers. The Artifact was built during the Nixanti-Fuminoid wars in 230 BY (Before Yomi) to force peace between the two warring factions, but it was never used as the two species met with Humans in a First Contact that ultimately led to the creation of Yomi Alliance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/a10a6b80f09ee541082f0eb51e89ec69a26d8f48.jpg[/img]

I will not spoil the other 5 missions and the final one.
Each mission will be played differently as different career path are chosen. If you are a security guard expect some heavy fighting, while you can try (and save countless lives) by choosing to be a diplomat. As a Doctor, on the other hand, you might be called to save the life of Captain Marston, whose life could mean the difference between a full scale conflict between the Nixanti and the Fuminoid.

Expect some heavy story-driven concept in May's update, as we prepare to end Academy days. Your romantic interest will also play a role in determine the fate of the galaxy, but I cannot (and don't want) to spoil more.

Thanks for following this project! I hope you'll enjoy the new content!

notes.title: Newest update will be out on March 30th!! With a new combat system!

Greetings space officers!

Thank you for your patience on the latest few weeks. I've been working as hard as I could to bring you new content to the game, and the next update will be FULL of great news!

notes.title: What's new in the next major release
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow space officers.

I am currently working at the next major release for Yomi Alliance, which will be ready to be delivered in a few weeks. The core concept of the next releases involves new dialogues and storylines with Sulijan, Aberoin and Lenara, with a lot of deep conversations and choices to pursue their relationships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/d6495cd03fadf9de15f1a28e0f96e071e6dc75a9.png[/img]

There is plenty to learn about them, as they are amongst the romanceable characters for the game. I am also considering to add new squad mates, but that's just a very early concept that will be explored as development progresses. The game is already huge as it is right now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/40083f414e825c328acb1d2d2110193d7f19548c.png[/img]

Another thing I want to improve in the game is the [b]immersion[/b]. You basically learn new skills every time you hit something on the calendar, but unless that specific skill has some related event to play you don't know WHAT is it that you're learning.

That's why I added flavor text for EVERY skill and for EVERY point value to better explain what you can do with your actual skill level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/d13f97d8fce3c870779845ae257a17d1953a7e07.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36027277/71d1c621f0cc872b1bb22a6237e25dc81e454ca8.png[/img]

This way I hope to increase the awareness of what each skill can actually do and why you're learning it. It was a very long (and also quite challenging) work, but I think I set it straight now and it will be ready for the release.

Some sex scenes have been added as well. I am also working on the first Academy mission, but  I doubt it will be ready for the next update, so I'm afraid you'll have to wait a bit for it (please remember that each mission I make is played differently for each career you choose, that's why writing them takes some time).

I hope you'll enjoy the new content in the game. It adds some new gameplay options as well as some new stories to explore. Alongside a new Codex interface for important lore informations, Yomi Alliance is taking shape update after update, with most release-bugs now gone.

Thank you for your support, you're helping me make this game live!

notes.title: Yomi Alliance Alpha Release 0.0.3 out on February 10th!
notes.notes:
[b]On February 10th the first Early Access release of Yomi Alliance will be available on Steam![/b] 

If you wish to support my games you can join [url=https://www.patreon.com/generalpractitioner]my Patreon page[/url] to unlock it a few days earlier and to receive a Steam Key as well (look at Patreon tiers' informations before pledging).

The game aims to be huge, and it's impossible that an early release such as this one will feature all the contents that will be available in a the months / years to come.

As Steam's release will be available on February 10th as well, you might be curious about the content available straight away, so here's what's to expect!

[list]
[*] A 5/6 hour-long gameplay
[*] Administration classes
[*] Athletics classes with challenges
[*] Computer Use classes
[*] Armed Combat classes with simulated fights against different enemies
[*] Inquire classes with sub-plot
[*] Negotiate classes with sub-plot
[*] Persuasion classes
[*] Psychology classes for Counselor Career
[*] 10 different conversations with Serena
[*] 4 different dates with Serena with sex animations
[*] Academy simulated mission for each different school
[*] Each profession unlocked (classes for each skill are still under development)
[*] 10 different "Academy Storyline" events
[*] Every species/gender availble to proper Patreon tiers
[*] 1215 static Full-HD images, 7 FULL-HD animations
[*] 45 Achievements (Steam version)
[*] One demo mission (Command School / Science school only)
[*] 19 audio tracks
[*] 18 different upbringings to customize your character and starting skills
[/list] 
[i](Political, Academic, Religious, Scientific, Artistic, Merchant, Diplomat's child, Famous Parents, Wealthy Family, Raised in a colony, Criminal Past, Nomadic Childhood, Raised in occupied world, Orphan, Athletic, Engineer Brat, Genetic Resequenced, Military Brat)[/i]

Upbringings will introduce new dialogues and events in the game as well as professions and species.

Every month I will release a new major update as I did with General Practitioner in the past, with hours of content and more events to unlock and play, all compatible with your earlier saved games! If you grab the game at release you will benefit from playing the newest versions the very moment they are available, and you will be supporting our game's development as being a very small studio we completely rely on you to survive.

I hope you'll have fun playing and exploring Yomi Alliance. I [u]need[/u] your feedback to turn this game into something completely different in the VNs scenario!

See you out there!
